He played college basketball for [[Northeastern Junior College|Northeastern JC]] and [[Little Rock Trojans men's basketball|Little Rock]]. ==College career== Edwards attended [[Mountain Pointe High School]] in [[Phoenix, Arizona]], where he starred at basketball.{{cite news |author1=Nick Piecoro |title=Where did he come from? |url=https://www.newspapers.com/clip/99049387/ |access-date=4 April 2022 |work=[[Arizona Republic]] |date=11 January 2005 |page=56 |via=[[Newspapers.com]]}} {{open access}} Following his graduation he played junior college basketball at the [[Northeastern Junior College]] before moving to [[University of Arkansas at Little Rock]], where he graduated in 2009.{{cite news |author1=Evin Demirel |title=Making a move |url=https://www.arkansasonline.com/news/2011/feb/22/making-move/ |access-date=4 April 2022 |work=[[Arkansas Democrat Gazette]] |date=22 February 2011}} ==Professional career== ===2009–10 season=== Edwards went undrafted in the 2009 NBA draft. On November 1, 2009, he was acquired by the Albuquerque Thunderbirds. On November 26, 2009, he was waived by the Thunderbirds.{{cite web|url=http://www.oursportscentral.com/services/releases/?id=3934075|title=Thunderbirds Finalize Opening Day Roster|date=26 November 2009|publisher=}} On December 16, 2009, he was re-acquired by the Thunderbirds.{{cite web|url=http://www.oursportscentral.com/services/releases/?id=3941547|title=T-Birds Add Edwards to Roster|date=16 December 2009|publisher=}} ===2010–11 season=== In July 2010, Edwards joined the Denver Nuggets for the 2010 NBA Summer League. On September 24, 2010, he signed with the Nuggets.{{cite web|url=http://www.nba.com/nuggets/news/training_camp_9242010.html|title=Nuggets announce 2010 training camp roster|website=[[NBA.com]] |publisher=}} However, he was later waived by the Nuggets on October 11, 2010.{{cite web|url=http://www.insidehoops.com/blog/?p=6647|title=Nuggets waive Shane Edwards and Courtney Sims :InsideHoops|website=www.insidehoops.com |date=October 11, 2010 }} On October 31, 2010, he was acquired by the [[New Mexico Thunderbirds]].{{cite news|title=Thunderbirds Announce Training Camp Invitees|url=http://cache.nba.com/dleague/newmexico/thunderbirds_invites.html|date=October 31, 2010|accessdate=February 28, 2014|work=NBA.com}} On February 3, 2011, he was named to the West All-Star roster for the 2011 NBA D-League All-Star Game.{{cite news|title=2011 NBA D-League All-Star Rosters Announced|url=http://www.nba.com/dleague/news/allstar_rosters_2011.html|accessdate=February 28, 2014|work=NBA.com|date=February 3, 2011|url-status=dead|archiveurl=https://web.archive.org/web/20140309141640/http://www.nba.com/dleague/news/allstar_rosters_2011.html|archivedate=March 9, 2014}} ===2011–12 season=== In July 2011, Edwards signed with [[Scaligera Basket Verona|Tezenis Verona]] of the Italian [[Serie A2 Gold Basket|Legadue Basket]] for the 2011–12 season.{{cite news|title=Tezenis Verona officially announces Shane Edwards|url=http://www.sportando.com/en/italy/lega-adecco-gold/87768/tezenis-verona-officially-announces-shane-edwards.html|accessdate=February 28, 2014|work=Sportando.com|date=July 31, 2011}} In December 2011, he left Verona after just nine games. On March 6, 2012, he was acquired by the [[Canton Charge]]. On April 2, 2012, he was waived by the Charge due to injury.{{cite web|url=http://www.nba.com/dleague/transactions_201112.html|title=2011-12 Transactions|website=[[NBA.com]] |publisher=}} ===2012–13 season=== On August 26, 2012, Edwards signed with [[Cairns Taipans]] for the [[2012–13 NBL season]].{{cite news|title=Taipans complete roster, sign second import Shane Edwards|url=http://andthefoul.net/archives/4471|accessdate=February 28, 2014|work=AndTheFoul.net|date=August 26, 2012}} ===2013–14 season=== In November 2013, Edwards was re-acquired by the Canton Charge.{{cite news|title=Canton Charge 2013-14 Training Camp Roster|url=http://www.nba.com/dleague/canton/news/canton_charge_announce_201314_2013_11_06.html|accessdate=February 28, 2014|work=NBA.com|date=November 14, 2013}} On March 12, 2014, he signed a 10-day contract with the [[Cleveland Cavaliers]].{{cite news|title=Cavs Sign Shane Edwards to 10-Day Contract|url=https://www.nba.com/cavaliers/releases/sign-edwards-10-day-140312|accessdate=March 12, 2014|work=NBA.com|date=March 12, 2014}} On March 21, 2014, he was released by the Cavaliers,{{cite news|title=Cavs Sign Seth Curry to 10-Day Contract|url=https://www.nba.com/cavaliers/releases/sign-curry-10-day-140321|accessdate=March 21, 2014|work=NBA.com|date=March 21, 2014}} and was immediately re-acquired by the Charge.{{cite news|title=Charge Reacquire Shane Edwards|url=http://www.nba.com/dleague/canton/news/charge_reacquire_shane_edwards_2014_03_21.html|accessdate=March 21, 2014|work=NBA.com|date=March 21, 2014|url-status=dead|archiveurl=https://web.archive.org/web/20140322115049/http://www.nba.com/dleague/canton/news/charge_reacquire_shane_edwards_2014_03_21.html|archivedate=March 22, 2014}} ===2014–15 season=== In July 2014, Edwards joined the Cleveland Cavaliers for the [[2014 NBA Summer League]].{{cite web|url=https://www.nba.com/cavaliers/releases/summer-league-roster-140708|title=Cavs Announce 2014 Samsung NBA Summer League Roster - Cleveland Cavaliers|website=[[NBA.com]] |publisher=}} On September 28, 2014, he signed with Cavaliers.{{cite web|url=https://www.nba.com/cavaliers/releases/signing-140928|title=Cavs Sign Chris Crawford and Shane Edwards - Cleveland Cavaliers|website=[[NBA.com]] |publisher=}} However, he was later waived by the Cavaliers on October 25, 2014.{{cite web|url=https://www.nba.com/cavaliers/releases/waive-edwards-141025|title=Cavs Waive Shane Edwards - Cleveland Cavaliers|website=[[NBA.com]] |publisher=}} On November 20, 2014, he signed with [[Sundsvall Dragons]] of Sweden for the rest of the 2014–15 season.{{cite news|title=Shane Edwards added by Sundsvall|url=http://www.court-side.com/news/blog/shane-edwards-added-sundsvall/|accessdate=December 20, 2014|work=Court-side.com|date=November 20, 2014}} ===2015–16 season=== On August 21, 2015, Edwards signed a one-year deal with [[BG Göttingen]] of the [[Basketball Bundesliga]].[http://www.sport1.de/basketball/beko-bbl/2015/08/bbl-bg-goettingen-verpflichtet-us-forward-shane-edwards BG Göttingen verstärkt sich weiter] {{in lang|de}} On January 11, 2016, he parted ways with Göttingen after averaging 11.7 points per game.{{cite web|url=http://www.sportando.com/en/europe/germany/187572/bg-goettingen-shane-edwards-part-ways.html|title=BG Goettingen, Shane Edwards part ways|work=Sportando |publisher=}} On February 20, 2016, he signed with the [[Alaska Aces (PBA)|Alaska Aces]] of the [[Philippine Basketball Association]] as a temporary replacement import for the injured [[Robert Dozier]].{{cite web|url=https://www.spin.ph/basketball/filoil/news/sos-for-alaska-as-aces-set-to-parade-shane-edwards-fro-injured-rob-dozier|title=Alaska set to parade Shane Edwards as temporary replacement for Rob Dozier - SPIN.PH|first=Gerry|last=Ramos|date=23 February 2016|publisher=}}{{cite news |author1=Levi Verora Jr |title=Edwards impresses in debut, doesn't mind playing interim role |url=https://tiebreakertimes.com.ph/tbt/edwards-impresses-in-debut-doesnt-mind-playing-interim-role/50497 |access-date=4 April 2022 |work=Tie Breaker Times |date=26 February 2016}} ===2016–17 season=== On March 15, 2017, Edwards was acquired by the [[Delaware 87ers]] of the [[NBA Development League]].{{cite web|url=http://delaware.dleague.nba.com/news/release-sevens-acquire-shane-edwards/|title=RELEASE: SEVENS ACQUIRE SHANE EDWARDS|date=March 15, 2017|work=NBA.com|accessdate=March 17, 2017}} After a short stint, he was released and acquired by the [[Nauticos de Mazatlán]] of the Mexican [[Circuito de Baloncesto de la Costa del Pacífico|CIBACOPA]].{{cite news|url=https://www.court-side.com/news/shane-edwards-now-playing-mazatlan/|title=Shane Edwards now playing for Mazatlan|publisher=court-side.com|date=May 1, 2017|accessdate=May 2, 2020}} ===2017–18 season=== In January 2018, Edwards signed with the [[CLS Knights Indonesia]] of the [[ASEAN Basketball League]].{{cite web|url=http://aseanbasketballleague.com/knights-make-changes-replaces-jones-edwards-2/|title=Knights Make Changes Again, Replace Jones with Edwards - ABL|website=aseanbasketballleague.com}} In March 2018, he signed with the [[Barangay Ginebra San Miguel]] of the [[Philippine Basketball Association]] as a temporary import for the [[2018 PBA Commissioner's Cup]].{{cite web|url=https://www.spin.ph/basketball/pba/news/ginebra-taps-shane-edwards-as-temporary-import-with-justine-brownlee-still-committed-with-alab-pilipinas|title=Ginebra taps Shane Edwards as temporary import with Brownlee still committed to Alab Pilipinas |first=Gerry|last=Ramos|date=22 March 2018|publisher=}} However, he was released in April 2018 before appearing in a regular season game.{{cite web|url=https://www.spin.ph/basketball/news/ginebra-set-to-bring-new-import-in-charles-garc|title=Ginebra bringing in new import Charles Garcia to replace Shane Edwards -
